question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.

WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.id as line_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as total_qty
    FROM orderlines ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
),
inventory_wh1 AS (
    SELECT i.id as inv_id, i.product_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty as inv_qty, p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) as rn
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1 AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines)
),
pick_allocation AS (
    SELECT ol.line_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.total_qty as order_qty,
           inv.product_id, inv.purchase_id, inv.inv_qty as available_qty, inv.purchased, inv.aisle, inv.position, inv.rn,
           SUM(inv.inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.purchased, inv.inv_qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cum_available
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN inventory_wh1 inv ON ol.product_id = inv.product_id
),
pick_with_prev AS (
    SELECT *,
           LAG(cum_available) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, available_qty) as prev_cum_available
    FROM pick_allocation
),
pick_calc AS (
    SELECT line_id, order_id, product_id, order_qty, purchase_id, available_qty, purchased, aisle, position, rn, cum_available, prev_cum_available,
           CASE 
               WHEN COALESCE(prev_cum_available, 0) >= order_qty THEN 0
               WHEN cum_available >= order_qty THEN order_qty - COALESCE(prev_cum_available, 0)
               ELSE available_qty
           END as qty_to_pick
    FROM pick_with_prev
)
SELECT line_id, order_id, product_id, aisle, position, qty_to_pick
FROM pick_calc WHERE qty_to_pick > 0
ORDER BY line_id, rn
